requests: Explain the best method to achieve a 12 ft clear span by supplementing the existing triple 2x10 beam with additional 2x10s (up to 16 ft) and removing one column
Explain how the new combined beam should be supported, including the end near the existing wall that needs its own support
reason: The reply addresses the method in general terms. It never explains how the combined beam or its new end should be supported, and the generic referral does not supply that requested detail.
